sources.title: Twenty Years of SynGAP Research: From Synapses to Cognition
sources.authors: Gamache TR, Araki Y, Huganir RL
sources.coverage: Main review: SynGAP1 structure, PDZ-PSD-95 interaction, LTP dispersal mechanism, SYNGAP1 +/- mouse phenotype, human mutations

sources.title: SYNGAP1: Mind the Gap
sources.coverage: Disease-focused review: SYNGAP1 ID/ASD/epilepsy, dendritic spine structure, AMPAR trafficking, developmental critical period

sources.title: Mutations in SYNGAP1 in Autosomal Nonsyndromic Mental Retardation
sources.authors: Hamdan FF et al. (Synapse to Disease Group)
sources.coverage: First human genetics study: 3 de novo SYNGAP1 truncating mutations in 94 ID patients; established human causality

sources.title: Research Progress in SYNGAP1-Related Neurodevelopmental Disorders
sources.authors: Zhang J, Xue G, Wang X, Rao X, Chen J, Fan L, Liu L, Gan J
sources.coverage: Latest (2026) clinical review: SRD phenotype spectrum, >200 patients, emerging precision therapies (AAV, ASO)

sources.title: A synaptic Ras-GTPase activating protein (p135 SynGAP) inhibited by CaM kinase II
sources.authors: Chen HJ, Rojas-Soto M, Oguni A, Kennedy MB
sources.coverage: Original SynGAP1 discovery paper; CaMKII regulation; NMDAR association

sources.title: Convergence of Hippocampal Pathophysiology in Syngap+/- and Fmr1-/y Mice
sources.authors: Barnes SA, Wijetunge LS, Jackson AD et al.
sources.coverage: Syngap+/- mouse model: elevated ERK, abnormal dendritic spine morphology, enhanced LTD; convergence with Fragile X pathophysiology via mGluR5-Ras-ERK axis
